description: What the user's Replo plan includes in Sightglass: the plan name, row caps per list, whether sales and traffic estimates are included, the history and trend windows, and how many new-brand researches are used and left this month. Call it when a result comes back with locked fields and the user asks why, or before sightglass_research_company. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_access
